Credits.Title: About & Credits
Credits.Author: Mistress Thorunn
Credits.Role: Author, Worldbuilder and Patron of the Metacoin System
Credits.Bio1: Mistress Thorunn is an author, worldbuilder, and professional TTRPG game master committed to two things: mastering horror with absurdly specific details, and utter tomfoolery.
Credits.Bio2: She is brilliantly meticulous about lore, consistency, atmosphere, and that tiny detail that nobody noticed—but she definitely did, and now it must be explored.
Credits.Bio3: She is also the creator of Vezonia and Strigovia, living universes she crafted and is adapting into setting books filled with geography, history, cultures, politics, religion, monsters, and characters that make a world feel alive even when no one is rolling dice in it.
Credits.GoldenRule: Use Metacoins to add trouble, never to steal player agency.
Credits.DownloadPdfDesc: Free formatted PDF containing all official rules and tables
